title: Review independence: last-resort builder family, diff-aware posting
summary: This change loosens the review-independence rule from a hard requirement to a preference. Builder-family detection now reads every word of a `Code-Generator:` trailer (vendor names and model ids alike) and reports per-commit reasons when a family is unknown, exempting clean merges via a scratch-object-store `git merge-tree` check. Reviewers of the builder's family are no longer simply skipped: they run as a last resort when no other family answered, and only with evidence naming each other-family reviewer and its error. Posting gains a diff-aware planner: findings whose path/line is not on the PR's right-hand diff side go into the body instead of an inline comment, and an unreadable diff degrades to body-only rather than failing. Oversized bodies are now cut and counted instead of refused.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: run(req, state_dir)
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a review: sets up the roster, runs reviewers of other families first, then retries builder-family reviewers as the last resort when a lens got no answer.

nodes.label: osf review post
nodes.subtitle: review_post_cmd
nodes.summary: Posts a saved run's findings. Now goes through `plan_for_post`, which fetches the PR diff only when a finding could be inline.

nodes.label: plan_for_post
nodes.subtitle: findings, summary, repo, pr -> Plan
nodes.summary: Decides whether the diff is needed, fetches it, and falls back to `DiffLines::unavailable()` when GitHub refuses it, so the review still posts.

nodes.label: builder::detect_detailed
nodes.subtitle: Detected { families, unknown }
nodes.summary: Reads each commit's `Code-Generator:` trailers, skips clean merges, maps every word of a model name through aliases then `agents::MODEL_FAMILIES`, and records a fixed-cause reason per unknown commit.

nodes.label: builder::family_of
nodes.subtitle: model_name, aliases -> family
nodes.summary: Matches every whitespace- and slash-separated word of the model name by prefix; a name whose words point to two families is `unknown` rather than guessed.

nodes.label: agents::MODEL_FAMILIES
nodes.subtitle: &[(&str, &str)]
nodes.summary: The shipped prefix table, now shared with `family_of` and widened to bare vendor names (`anthropic`, `openai`, `google`) plus `codex`.

nodes.label: ReviewerRun
nodes.subtitle: + not_run: Option<String>
nodes.summary: A saved reviewer run now records why it made no attempt, so an empty attempt list no longer reads as a clean result.

nodes.label: judge_lens / settle_last_resort
nodes.subtitle: LensVerdict, Judged, interim, notes
nodes.summary: Judges each reviewer's saved attempts, then decides whether builder-family reviewers count as the last resort, requiring evidence from every other-family reviewer that was actually tried.

nodes.label: last_resort_evidence
nodes.subtitle: others -> Result<Vec<String>, String>
nodes.summary: Builds one line per other-family reviewer saying why it could not answer; errors when any was never tried, since an untried reviewer is no evidence.

nodes.label: plan_review_in_diff
nodes.subtitle: findings, summary, diff -> Plan
nodes.summary: Splits findings into inline comments (on the diff) and body entries (outside it), appends the outside heading, and cuts the body to the limit instead of refusing.

nodes.label: DiffLines
nodes.subtitle: parse / contains / unavailable
nodes.summary: Parses a unified diff's hunk headers into per-file right-side line ranges, so a finding can be checked against the lines GitHub accepts comments on.

nodes.label: append_outside_findings
nodes.subtitle: summary, findings -> body
nodes.summary: Fits as many unanchored findings as the body limit allows, then a line counting the rest, cutting the summary on a character boundary when needed.

nodes.label: git::is_clean_merge
nodes.subtitle: dir, hash -> bool
nodes.summary: A merge is clean when it has exactly two parents and `merge-tree --write-tree` of them equals its own tree; anything else fails closed.

nodes.label: merge_tree_in_scratch_store
nodes.subtitle: GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY=scratch
nodes.summary: Runs `git merge-tree --write-tree` with a temp object store and the repo's objects as an alternate, so a read-only checkout is never written to.
